training_identity: 512 cached training environments, expanded exact IDs saved in output config
hypothesis: learn a frequency-independent real generator correction from context-derived local normal equations; analytic complex propagation supplies phase rather than an independent per-frequency output head
supervision: true projected slowness-squared coefficients used as training labels only; single coefficient MSE; field raw error chooses development checkpoint
controls: same-input classical local inverse, quintic/range-regularized inverse, same-training-data RBF residual regression, true-medium projection oracle
stop_rule: candidate must beat strongest matched classical and supervised kernel by 20% and retain raw <=.10 before three-seed/fractional/source/domain expansion; no capacity sweep on failure
scope: development mechanism pilot; inverse physics and FNO are prior art; no formal novelty or two-domain claim
